stotra.description: Aditya Hrudayam is a hymn directed to the Sun God, taught to Rama by sage Agastya.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: ॐ अस्य आदित्य हृदयस्तोत्रस्यागस्त्यऋषिरनुष्टुपछन्दः , आदित्येहृदयभूतो भगवान ब्रह्मा देवता निरस्ताशेषविघ्नतया ब्रह्मविद्यासिद्धौ सर्वत्र जयसिद्धौ च विनियोगः ।।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: om asya ādityahṛdayastotrasyāgastyaṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ , ādityehṛdayabhūto bhagavān brahmā devatā nirastāśeṣavighnatayā brahmavidyāsiddhau sarvatra jayasiddhau ca viniyogaḥ .
shlokas.meaning_english: Om. Of this Aditya Hrudaya Stotram, Sage Agastya is the Rishi (seer), Anustup is the meter, and the Supreme Lord Brahma, who resides as the inner soul of the Sun, is the deity. This chant is dedicated (applied) for the complete removal of all obstacles, for the realization of Brahma-Vidya (Supreme Knowledge), and for achieving victory in all endeavors.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: ॐ। इस आदित्य हृदय स्तोत्र के ऋषि अगस्त्य हैं, छंद अनुष्टुप है, और भगवान ब्रह्मा (जो सूर्य के अंतर्यामी रूप हैं) इसके देवता हैं। इसका विनियोग सभी विघ्नों के नाश, ब्रह्मविद्या की प्राप्ति और सर्वत्र विजय के लिए किया जाता है।

padas.sanskrit_split: हृदय + स्तोत्रस्य + अगस्त्यः + ऋषिः + अनुष्टुप् + छन्दः
padas.meaning: of the heart hymn, Agastya is the sage, Anushtup is the meter
by the removal of all obstacles
in the attainment of supreme knowledge

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नमस्सवित्रे जगदेक चक्षुसे । जगत्प्रसूति स्थिति नाशहेतवे । त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्म धारिणे । विरिञ्चि नारायण शङ्करात्मने ॥
shlokas.iast_transliteration: namasavitre jagadeka cakṣuse | jagatprasūti sthiti nāśahetave | trayīmayāya triguṇātma dhāriṇe | viriñci nārāyaṇa śaṅkarātmane ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the Sun God (Savitur), who is the singular eye of the entire universe, and the ultimate cause behind the creation, preservation, and dissolution of the world. I bow to Him who embodies the three Vedas, sustains the three gunas (cosmic attributes), and manifests the unified essence of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: संपूर्ण जगत के एकमात्र नेत्र, जगत की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और विनाश के कारण, तीनों वेदों (ऋग, यजु, साम) के स्वरूप, तीनों गुणों (सत्त्व, रज, तम) को धारण करने वाले तथा ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और शिव के रूप भगवान सूर्य (सविता) को नमस्कार है।

padas.meaning: that excellent glory of the sun

shlokas.full_sanskrit: ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तꣳ समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् । रावणꣳ चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: ततो | युद्धपरिश्रान्तꣳ | समरे | चिन्तया | स्थितम् | रावणꣳ | चाग्रतो | दृष्ट्वा | युद्धाय | समुपस्थितम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: tato yuddhapariśrāntaṁ samare cintayā sthitam | rāvaṇaṁ cāgrato dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya samupasthitam ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Beholding Sri Rama, standing absorbed in deep thought on the battle-field, exhausted by the fight and facing Ravana who was duly prepared for the war,
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Beholding Sri Rama, standing absorbed in deep thought on the battle-field, exhausted by the fight and facing Ravana who was duly prepared for the war,

shlokas.full_sanskrit: दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो । रणम् उपागम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवान् ऋषिः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: दैवतैश्च | समागम्य | द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो | रणम् | उपागम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो | भगवान् | ऋषिः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: daivataiśca samāgamya draṣṭumabhyāgato | raṇam upāgamyābravīdrāmamagastyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: the glorious sage Agastya, who had come in the company of gods to witness the encounter (battle) now spoke to Rama as follows:
shlokas.meaning_hindi: the glorious sage Agastya, who had come in the company of gods to witness the encounter (battle) now spoke to Rama as follows:

shlokas.full_sanskrit: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यꣳ । सनातनम् येन सर्वानरीन् वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसि ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: राम | राम | महाबाहो | शृणु | गुह्यꣳ | सनातनम् | येन | सर्वानरीन् | वत्स | समरे | विजयिष्यसि
shlokas.iast_transliteration: rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṁ | sanātanam yena sarvānarīn vatsa samare vijayiṣyasi ||
shlokas.meaning_english: 'O Rama', 'O Mighty armed elegant Rama', listen carefully to the eternal secret by which, 'O my child', you shall conquer all your enemies on the battle field and win against your adversaries.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: 'O Rama', 'O Mighty armed elegant Rama', listen carefully to the eternal secret by which, 'O my child', you shall conquer all your enemies on the battle field and win against your adversaries.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: आदित्यहृदयꣳ पुण्यꣳ सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहꣳ जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यꣳ परमꣳ शिवम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आदित्यहृदयꣳ | पुण्यꣳ | सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् | जयावहꣳ | जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यꣳ | परमꣳ | शिवम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ādityahṛdayaṁ puṇyaṁ sarvaśatruvināśanam | jayāvahaṁ japennityamakṣayyaṁ paramaṁ śivam ||
shlokas.meaning_english: By Chanting the Aditya-Hridayam (the meditation of Sun in the heart ) which is very auspicious and highly beneficial, you will be victorious in battle. This holy hymn dedicated to the Sun-God will result in destroying all enemies and bring you victory and permanent happiness.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: By Chanting the Aditya-Hridayam (the meditation of Sun in the heart ) which is very auspicious and highly beneficial, you will be victorious in battle. This holy hymn dedicated to the Sun-God will result in destroying all enemies and bring you victory and permanent happiness.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्यꣳ सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्यꣳ | सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् | चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṁ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam ||
shlokas.meaning_english: This supreme prayer is the best amongst all auspicious mantras, it will destroy all sins, dispel all doubts, alleviate worry and sorrow, anxiety and anguish, and increase the longevity of life.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: This supreme prayer is the best amongst all auspicious mantras, it will destroy all sins, dispel all doubts, alleviate worry and sorrow, anxiety and anguish, and increase the longevity of life.

padas.meaning: the most auspicious among all auspicious things

shlokas.full_sanskrit: रश्मिमन्तꣳ समुद्यन्तꣳ देवासुरनमस्कृतम् । पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तꣳ भास्करꣳ भुवनेश्वरम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: रश्मिमन्तꣳ | समुद्यन्तꣳ | देवासुरनमस्कृतम् | पूजयस्व | विवस्वन्तꣳ | भास्करꣳ | भुवनेश्वरम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: raśmimantaṁ samudyantaṁ devāsuranamaskṛtam | pūjayasva vivasvantaṁ bhāskaraṁ bhuvaneśvaram ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Worship the Sun-God, the ruler of the worlds and lord of the universe, who is crowned with effulgent rays, who appears at the horizon and to whom both the gods and the demons offer their prostrations.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Worship the Sun-God, the ruler of the worlds and lord of the universe, who is crowned with effulgent rays, who appears at the horizon and to whom both the gods and the demons offer their prostrations.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः । एष देवासुरगणान् लोकान् पाति गभस्तिभिः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सर्वदेवात्मको | ह्येष | तेजस्वी | रश्मिभावनः | एष | देवासुरगणान् | लोकान् | पाति | गभस्तिभिः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: sarvadevātmako hyeṣa tejasvī raśmibhāvanaḥ | eṣa devāsuragaṇān lokān pāti gabhastibhiḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Indeed, He is the very embodiment of all Gods. He is self-luminous and sustains all with his rays. He nourishes and energizes the inhabitants of all the worlds as well as the host of Gods and demons by his Rays.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Indeed, He is the very embodiment of all Gods. He is self-luminous and sustains all with his rays. He nourishes and energizes the inhabitants of all the worlds as well as the host of Gods and demons by his Rays.

padas.meaning: the worlds of gods and demons

shlokas.full_sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः । प्रजापतिः महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपाम्पतिः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: एष | ब्रह्मा | च | विष्णुश्च | शिवः | स्कन्दः | प्रजापतिः | महेन्द्रो | धनदः | कालो | यमः | सोमो | ह्यपाम्पतिः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaḥ skandaḥ | prajāpatiḥ mahendro dhanadaḥ kālo yamaḥ somo hyapāmpatiḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Skanda, Prajapati, the mighty Indra, Kubera, Kala, Yama, Soma and Varuna.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Skanda, Prajapati, the mighty Indra, Kubera, Kala, Yama, Soma and Varuna.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: पितरो वसवः साध्या ह्यश्विनौ मरुतो । मनुः वायुर्वह्निः प्रजाप्राण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: पितरो | वसवः | साध्या | ह्यश्विनौ | मरुतो | मनुः | वायुर्वह्निः | प्रजाप्राण | ऋतुकर्ता | प्रभाकरः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hyaśvinau maruto | manuḥ vāyurvahniḥ prajāprāṇa ṛtukartā prabhākaraḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the Pitrs, the eight Vasus, the Sadhyas, the twin Ashvins, the Maruts, Manu, Vayu, Agni, Prana and, being the source of all energy and light, is the maker of all the six seasons.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the Pitrs, the eight Vasus, the Sadhyas, the twin Ashvins, the Maruts, Manu, Vayu, Agni, Prana and, being the source of all energy and light, is the maker of all the six seasons.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः । पूषा गभस्तिमान् सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आदित्यः | सविता | सूर्यः | खगः | पूषा | गभस्तिमान् | सुवर्णसदृशो | भानुर्हिरण्यरेता | दिवाकरः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ādityaḥ savitā sūryaḥ khagaḥ | pūṣā gabhastimān suvarṇasadṛśo bhānurhiraṇyaretā divākaraḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the son of Aditi, the creator of the universe, the inspirer of action, the traveler in the heavens. He nourishes all, possesses rays, is golden, brilliant, the seed of the universe and the maker of the day.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the son of Aditi, the creator of the universe, the inspirer of action, the traveler in the heavens. He nourishes all, possesses rays, is golden, brilliant, the seed of the universe and the maker of the day.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिमरीचिमान् । तिमिरोन्मथनः शम्भुस्त्वष्टा मार्ताण्ड अꣳशुमान् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: हरिदश्वः | सहस्रार्चिः | सप्तसप्तिमरीचिमान् | तिमिरोन्मथनः | शम्भुस्त्वष्टा | मार्ताण्ड | अꣳशुमान्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: haridaśvaḥ sahasrārciḥ saptasaptimarīcimān | timironmathanaḥ śambhustvaṣṭā mārtāṇḍa aṁśumān ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He has green horses, thousands of rays, is mounted on seven horses, illuminates the world, destroys darkness, is the source of happiness, the shaper of all forms, the imparter of life to the lifeless cosmic egg, and the possessor of rays.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He has green horses, thousands of rays, is mounted on seven horses, illuminates the world, destroys darkness, is the source of happiness, the shaper of all forms, the imparter of life to the lifeless cosmic egg, and the possessor of rays.

padas.meaning: drawn by seven horses, full of rays

shlokas.full_sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनो भास्करो रविः । अग्निगर्भोऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भः | शिशिरस्तपनो | भास्करो | रविः | अग्निगर्भोऽदितेः | पुत्रः | शङ्खः | शिशिरनाशनः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śiśirastapano bhāskaro raviḥ | agnigarbho'diteḥ putraḥ śaṅkhaḥ śiśiranāśanaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the golden womb, the cooler, the heater, the illuminator, the praiser, the fire within, the son of Aditi, the pacifier, and the destroyer of cold.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the golden womb, the cooler, the heater, the illuminator, the praiser, the fire within, the son of Aditi, the pacifier, and the destroyer of cold.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी ऋग्यजुस्सामपारगः । घनवृष्टिरपाꣳ मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी | ऋग्यजुस्सामपारगः | घनवृष्टिरपाꣳ | मित्रो | विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: vyomanāthastamobhedī ṛgyajussāmapāragaḥ | ghanavṛṣṭirapāṁ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṅgamaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the lord of the firmament, dispeller of darkness, master of the three Vedas, sender of thick showers, friend of water, and the one who crosses the Vindhya range.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the lord of the firmament, dispeller of darkness, master of the three Vedas, sender of thick showers, friend of water, and the one who crosses the Vindhya range.

padas.meaning: lord of the sky, dispeller of darkness
master of Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas
cause of heavy rain, of waters
swift traverser of the Vindhya path

shlokas.full_sanskrit: आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः । सर्वतापनः कविर्विश्वो महातेजाः रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आतपी | मण्डली | मृत्युः | पिङ्गलः | सर्वतापनः | कविर्विश्वो | महातेजाः | रक्तः | सर्वभवोद्भवः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ātapī maṇḍalī mṛtyuḥ piṅgalaḥ | sarvatāpanaḥ kavirviśvo mahātejāḥ raktaḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the heat-giver, the orb, death itself, tawny, the destroyer of all, the omniscient, the all-formed, the highly brilliant, the red one, and the source of all existence.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the heat-giver, the orb, death itself, tawny, the destroyer of all, the omniscient, the all-formed, the highly brilliant, the red one, and the source of all existence.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः तेजसामपि । तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो | विश्वभावनः | तेजसामपि | तेजस्वी | द्वादशात्मन्नमोऽस्तु | ते
shlokas.iast_transliteration: nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmadhipo viśvabhāvanaḥ tejasāmapi | tejasvī dvādaśātmannamo'stu te ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He is the lord of stars, planets, and constellations, the origin of the universe, the most resplendent among the splendid. Salutations to You who manifest in twelve forms.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He is the lord of stars, planets, and constellations, the origin of the universe, the most resplendent among the splendid. Salutations to You who manifest in twelve forms.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमायाद्रये । नमः ज्योतिर्गणानाꣳ पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: नमः | पूर्वाय | गिरये | पश्चिमायाद्रये | नमः | ज्योतिर्गणानाꣳ | पतये | दिनाधिपतये | नमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścimāyādraye | namaḥ jyotirgaṇānāṁ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the eastern mountain and the western mountain. Salutations to the lord of the stellar bodies and the lord of the day.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the eastern mountain and the western mountain. Salutations to the lord of the stellar bodies and the lord of the day.

padas.meaning: to the lord of the day

shlokas.full_sanskrit: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः । नमो नमः सहस्राꣳशो आदित्याय नमो नमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: जयाय | जयभद्राय | हर्यश्वाय | नमो | नमः | नमो | नमः | सहस्राꣳशो | आदित्याय | नमो | नमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: jayāya jayabhadrāya haryaśvāya namo namaḥ | namo namaḥ sahasrāṁśo ādityāya namo namaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the bestower of victory, the bestower of auspicious victory, the one with green horses. Salutations to the thousand-rayed one, the son of Aditi.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the bestower of victory, the bestower of auspicious victory, the one with green horses. Salutations to the thousand-rayed one, the son of Aditi.

padas.meaning: to the bringer of auspicious victory
to the one with green horses
O one with a thousand rays

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो । नमः नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: नम | उग्राय | वीराय | सारङ्गाय | नमो | नमः | नमः | पद्मप्रबोधाय | मार्ताण्डाय | नमो | नमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: nama ugrāya vīrāya sāraṅgāya namo | namaḥ namaḥ padmaprabodhāya mārtāṇḍāya namo namaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the fierce one, the valiant one, the swift one. Salutations to the awakener of the lotus, the son of Mrikanda.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the fierce one, the valiant one, the swift one. Salutations to the awakener of the lotus, the son of Mrikanda.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे भास्वते । सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय | सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे | भास्वते | सर्वभक्षाय | रौद्राय | वपुषे | नमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: brahmeśānācyuteśāya sūryāyādityavarcase bhāsvate | sarvabhakṣāya raudrāya vapuṣe namaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the lord of Brahma, Shiva, and Vishnu, the sun god, the radiant one, the consumer of all, the fierce-bodied one.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the lord of Brahma, Shiva, and Vishnu, the sun god, the radiant one, the consumer of all, the fierce-bodied one.

padas.meaning: to the Lord of Brahma, Shiva, and Vishnu
to Surya, of shining Aditya brilliance

shlokas.full_sanskrit: तमोघ्नाय हिमघ्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने कृतघ्नघ्नाय । देवाय ज्योतिषाꣳ पतये नमः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: तमोघ्नाय | हिमघ्नाय | शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने | कृतघ्नघ्नाय | देवाय | ज्योतिषाꣳ | पतये | नमः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: tamoghnāya himaghnāya śatrughnāyāmitātmane kṛtaghnaghnāya | devāya jyotiṣāṁ pataye namaḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the dispeller of darkness, the destroyer of cold, the annihilator of foes, the one of boundless essence, the destroyer of the ungrateful, the divine one, the lord of lights.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the dispeller of darkness, the destroyer of cold, the annihilator of foes, the one of boundless essence, the destroyer of the ungrateful, the divine one, the lord of lights.

padas.meaning: to the destroyer of enemies, of boundless spirit
to the destroyer of the ungrateful

shlokas.full_sanskrit: तप्तचामीकराभाय वह्नये विश्वकर्मणे । नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: तप्तचामीकराभाय | वह्नये | विश्वकर्मणे | नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय | रुचये | लोकसाक्षिणे
shlokas.iast_transliteration: taptacāmīkarābhāya vahnaye viśvakarmaṇe | namastamobhinighnāya rucaye lokasākṣiṇe ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to the one with the luster of molten gold, the fire, the architect of the universe, the destroyer of darkness, the radiant one, the witness of the world.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Salutations to the one with the luster of molten gold, the fire, the architect of the universe, the destroyer of darkness, the radiant one, the witness of the world.

padas.meaning: to the one shining like molten gold
to the creator of the universe
salutations to the destroyer of darkness
to the witness of the world

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नाशयत्येष वै भूतꣳ तदेव सृजति । प्रभुः पायत्येव तपत्येष वर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: नाशयत्येष | वै | भूतꣳ | तदेव | सृजति | प्रभुः | पायत्येव | तपत्येष | वर्षत्येष | गभस्तिभिः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṁ tadeva sṛjati | prabhuḥ pāyatyeva tapatyeṣa varṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He indeed destroys all beings and He alone creates them again. He protects, heats, and causes rain with His rays.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He indeed destroys all beings and He alone creates them again. He protects, heats, and causes rain with His rays.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः । एष एवाग्निहोत्रꣳ च फलꣳ चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: एष | सुप्तेषु | जागर्ति | भूतेषु | परिनिष्ठितः | एष | एवाग्निहोत्रꣳ | च | फलꣳ | चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ | eṣa evāgnihotraṁ ca phalaṁ caivāgnihotriṇām ||
shlokas.meaning_english: He remains awake when all beings are asleep, situated within them. He is both the sacrificial fire and the fruit enjoyed by the performers of the sacrifice.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: He remains awake when all beings are asleep, situated within them. He is both the sacrificial fire and the fruit enjoyed by the performers of the sacrifice.

padas.meaning: and also of those performing the fire sacrifice

shlokas.full_sanskrit: वेदाश्च कृतवश्चैव क्रतूनाꣳ फलमैव च यानि । कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: वेदाश्च | कृतवश्चैव | क्रतूनाꣳ | फलमैव | च | यानि | कृत्यानि | लोकेषु | सर्व | एष | रविः | प्रभुः
shlokas.iast_transliteration: vedāśca kṛtavaścaiva kratūnāṁ phalamaiva ca yāni | kṛtyāni lokeṣu sarva eṣa raviḥ prabhuḥ ||
shlokas.meaning_english: The Vedas, the sacrifices, and the fruits of sacrifices—whatever actions there are in all the worlds—all these are but the sun god, the lord.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: The Vedas, the sacrifices, and the fruits of sacrifices—whatever actions there are in all the worlds—all these are but the sun god, the lord.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु । च कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नवसीदति राघव ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: एनमापत्सु | कृच्छ्रेषु | कान्तारेषु | भयेषु | च | कीर्तयन् | पुरुषः | कश्चिन्नवसीदति | राघव
shlokas.iast_transliteration: enamāpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu | ca kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścinnavasīdati rāghava ||
shlokas.meaning_english: O Raghava, any man who glorifies Him in times of distress, difficulty, in the wilderness, or in times of fear will never come to grief.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: O Raghava, any man who glorifies Him in times of distress, difficulty, in the wilderness, or in times of fear will never come to grief.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवꣳ जगत्पतिम् एतत् । त्रिगदितꣳ जप्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यसि ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो | देवदेवꣳ | जगत्पतिम् | एतत् | त्रिगदितꣳ | जप्वा | युद्धेषु | विजयिष्यसि
shlokas.iast_transliteration: pūjayasvainamekāgro devadevaṁ jagatpatim etat | trigaditaṁ japvā yuddheṣu vijayiṣyasi ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Worship Him, the god of gods, the lord of the universe, with a one-pointed mind. By chanting this thrice, you will emerge victorious in battles.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Worship Him, the god of gods, the lord of the universe, with a one-pointed mind. By chanting this thrice, you will emerge victorious in battles.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणꣳ त्वꣳ । वधिस्यसि एवमुक्त्वा तदागस्त्यो जगाम च यथागतम् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: अस्मिन् | क्षणे | महाबाहो | रावणꣳ | त्वꣳ | वधिस्यसि | एवमुक्त्वा | तदागस्त्यो | जगाम | च | यथागतम्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṁ tvaṁ | vadhisyasi evamuktvā tadāgastyo jagāma ca yathāgatam ||
shlokas.meaning_english: O mighty-armed one, you will slay Ravana at this very moment. Having spoken thus, Agastya departed as he had come.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: O mighty-armed one, you will slay Ravana at this very moment. Having spoken thus, Agastya departed as he had come.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोकोभवत्तदा । धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा | महातेजा | नष्टशोकोभवत्तदा | धारयामास | सुप्रीतो | राघवः | प्रयतात्मवान्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: etacchrutvā mahātejā naṣṭaśokobhavattadā | dhārayāmāsa suprīto rāghavaḥ prayatātmavān ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Hearing this, the highly radiant Raghava became free from sorrow. Very pleased and with a controlled mind, he retained it in his memory.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Hearing this, the highly radiant Raghava became free from sorrow. Very pleased and with a controlled mind, he retained it in his memory.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: आदित्यꣳ प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वा तु परꣳ । हर्षमवाप्तवान् त्रिराचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आदित्यꣳ | प्रेक्ष्य | जप्त्वा | तु | परꣳ | हर्षमवाप्तवान् | त्रिराचम्य | शुचिर्भूत्वा | धनुरादाय | वीर्यवान्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ādityaṁ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṁ | harṣamavāptavān trirācamya śucirbhūtvā dhanurādāya vīryavān ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Gazing at the sun and reciting it, he attained supreme joy. Sipping water thrice, becoming purified, the valiant one took up his bow.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Gazing at the sun and reciting it, he attained supreme joy. Sipping water thrice, becoming purified, the valiant one took up his bow.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: रावणꣳ प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धाय समुपागमत् । सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतोऽभवत् ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: रावणꣳ | प्रेक्ष्य | हृष्टात्मा | युद्धाय | समुपागमत् | सर्वयत्नेन | महता | वधे | तस्य | धृतोऽभवत्
shlokas.iast_transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā yuddhāya samupāgamat | sarvayatnena mahatā vadhe tasya dhṛto'bhavat ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Seeing Ravana, he approached for battle with a gladdened heart. With all his mighty effort, he became resolved on his destruction.
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Seeing Ravana, he approached for battle with a gladdened heart. With all his mighty effort, he became resolved on his destruction.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: अथ रविरवदन् निरीक्ष्य रामꣳ मुदितमनाः । परमꣳ प्रहृष्यमाणः निशिचरपतिसङ्क्षयꣳ विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति ॥
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: अथ | रविरवदन् | निरीक्ष्य | रामꣳ | मुदितमनाः | परमꣳ | प्रहृष्यमाणः | निशिचरपतिसङ्क्षयꣳ | विदित्वा | सुरगणमध्यगतो | वचस्त्वरेति
shlokas.iast_transliteration: atha raviravadan nirīkṣya rāmaṁ muditamanāḥ | paramaṁ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ niśicarapatisaṅkṣayaṁ viditvā suragaṇamadhyagato vacastvareti ||
shlokas.meaning_english: Then the sun god, looking at Rama with a gladdened mind, highly rejoicing, knowing the impending destruction of the lord of night-rangers, spoken from amidst the host of gods: 'Make haste!'
shlokas.meaning_hindi: Then the sun god, looking at Rama with a gladdened mind, highly rejoicing, knowing the impending destruction of the lord of night-rangers, spoken from amidst the host of gods: 'Make haste!'

padas.meaning: the destruction of the lord of night-rangers (Ravana)
standing in the midst of the host of gods
